items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Vic Dickenson) does not speak in the provided context. The mention of Warren Vache is made solely by the Interviewer.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. There's one in particular that I know that he'll probably some-day be one of the good ones, and that's a guy named Warren Vache. I don't think he's 20 yet, you know, but he plays like mad. He's beautiful.
Yeah. I was surprised how much he had improved when I heard him.
